description: This Dart file defines the AnalyticsScreen widget for a Flutter application, including UI components to display quiz analytics, KPIs, filters, and related widgets.

classes.name: AnalyticsScreen
classes.description: A ConsumerWidget that displays quiz analytics, filters, KPIs, and per-quiz performance metrics.

classes.name: KpiCard
classes.description: A reusable widget representing a KPI tile with icon, title, and value.

classes.name: SparkBar
classes.description: A compact, animated bar component visualizing a percentage value for performance metrics.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the AnalyticsScreen, manages state, and assembles all UI components.

methods.name: _filterBar
methods.description: Builds the filter section with category dropdown and date range picker.

methods.name: _isSameRange
methods.description: Checks if the current filter range matches a preset number of days.

methods.name: _presetChip
methods.description: Creates a ChoiceChip for quick date range selection.

methods.name: _allChip
methods.description: Creates a ChoiceChip for selecting all date ranges.

methods.name: _rangeLabel
methods.description: Formats the date range label for display.

methods.name: _quizStatTile
methods.description: Builds a widget displaying statistics for a specific quiz.

methods.name: _pill
methods.description: Creates a small pill-shaped label widget.

methods.name: _emptyStateFiltered
methods.description: Builds the UI shown when no data matches current filters.
